limitation: Fornix remains partial: bilateral crural/posterior interiors, body and upper columns. Both posterior portions continue to the body; full fimbria and mammillary continuity remain unrecorded. Boundaries are approximate. Not expert-reviewed.

primaryReview.rationale: Existing same-specimen native100 Y730..780 interior contours were sampled at tissue centres and inspected in eleven orthogonal footprint views. Historical six fissure holds and two new bright/edge uncertainties remain excluded; eleven tiny pieces are held. Both posterior portions join the existing body/column regions without morphological gap filling. This demonstrates label continuity within the reviewed extent, not a complete fornix or microscopic tract boundary.
